params.message:
The old id of a deleted car follows the car

Whether a partner takes over the new id from the answer to an update is not in the platform's hands. An update that names a deleted car of the caller's dealer is now about the live car with the same chassis number when the dealer has one: a regular partner's call becomes a proposal on that car, a premium partner's call updates it. Without a live car it stays a create.

Portal: Een partner die het oude nummer van een verwijderde wagen blijft sturen, bereikt nu de wagen zoals ze vandaag in Stocklist staat.
